mission.title: All the King's Men
mission.description: Recover a Twin's torso and head from the Crushers and help the Effectuator put him back together.

npc.say: Looks like the day won't be a total loss after all.
It won't listen; all it does is kick me in the shins.

phase.briefing:
Operatives were...led to two of our missing hands; however, there are still a few fragments left to be gathered up before we can put our first ghostly Humpty Dumpty back together again. We've finally picked up the signal for the torso and head; they appear to have fallen in the Slums, where they were scavenged by the Bag Lady, who, in a sordid series of transactions, eventually put them in the hands of Mockingbird.
Mockingbird is having them guarded by hirelings from Gracy Heights, the Crushers. Apparently she is unaware that we are tracking the pieces by their unique code signals. The element of surprise should be on your side.

enter.say: I've got a lot of Exile signals in there. I've also got the signals for the torso and head, but they're faint; they've probably got them shut up in a safe.

objective.text: Get the Twin Head Frag from the safe

done.say: Now there's an ugly mug I never thought I'd see again.

objective.text: Get the Twin Torso Frag from the safe

done.say: Would have been a shame to leave that lying around...

near.say: Looks like the day won't be a total loss after all.

phase.briefing:
I'm relieved to see that you can at least deal with a pack of low-wattage muscle-heads like the Crushers.
You're to take those pieces of dead weight to the Effectuator. Hopefully he puts the head on backwards; it would improve their looks.

enter.say: Mr. Barrel o' Fun is in there.

talk.say:
How-do, partner? I hear you've got some pieces of meat for me! It's nice that I can touch these things--we're kind of immaterial soul-brothers, you know? Except I can't turn mine on and off the way they can. Oh well.
Lemme take that torso off your hands!

objective.text: Give the Twin Torso Frag to the Effectuator

done.say: He's just rezzed in another instance of himself.

Oof! That's a big chunk of man!
Uh... Hold on a sec, I need another pair of arms here.

What? A man's live, disembodied head? Eww! Get it away!
Oh? Oh. Oh, all right, give it here.

objective.text: Give the Twin Head Frag to the Effectuator

done.say: Got a new code signature in there... Aha. It's another half-baked Exile.

Huh, not too much worse for all those years bumping around up in the great wide open. Okay, stand back, here goes nothing!
Hah! Now that's traveling in style!
Stop wasting time with that halfwit, and bring the subject outside!

objective.text: Lead the Half Twin out of the area

phase.briefing: I need you to lead that floating albino to his lower half; we haven't been able to get it to cooperate at all. Maybe it will listen to reason when its head is present.

enter.say: Yeah... The other half of the code signature is in there. I hope they...like each other.

objective.text: Lead the Half Twin to the other Half Twin

done.say:
This is too weird.
All right... Try to get those two...halves to follow you out.
Let's get this taken care of.

objective.text: Lead both Half Twins out of the area
Don't let the first Half Twin die
Don't let the second Half Twin die

phase.briefing: Do not dawdle in the street with those things, {player}; who knows what kind of germs they might pick up.

enter.say:
This is the last time I try conducting a pair of legs across the city!
The Effectuators are in there. Time for some fireworks, methinks.

objective.text: Lead both Half Twins to the Effectuator

done.say: I've got a new program signal in there! Well, whaddaya know; looks like we're halfway to twindom. Better see if he's all there.
Voila! One Twin, good as new!

And the big galoot is back in the game!
Well, one of them, anyway. I never could tell them apart.

talk.say:
Ah. That's something.
Where's my brother?

done.say: Sounds all right, I guess. Now, will this make Flood happy, or crabby? My money's on crabby.
The two half shells are still there, but I'm showing no real activity for them. I guess they're just empty husks now--poor devils.
Floating up in the stratosphere? This won't do. No, this won't do at all.

mission.finish:
Very well, I don't need to hear all the insipid details.
The Merovingian has just used our last remaining cheat code. I expect we'll be running about collecting odd bits of the other Twin shortly. And then we'll have them back; won't that be...lovely.
